name: tokentrail
description: A privacy-first desktop dashboard for understanding local Codex usage.
author: Aman Ali

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && npm run check:budget
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:accessibility: npm run build && playwright test tests/accessibility
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e
scripts.test:security: npm run build && playwright test tests/security
scripts.test:packaged: npm run package:dir && playwright test tests/packaged
scripts.test:performance: npm run package:dir && playwright test tests/performance
scripts.package:appimage: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run check:format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:integration
